system.description:
Homebrew Feat (tovec.wikidot.com/episode-vii)

Weapon Specialization can be taken as a Feat or as a Talent. Either counts as Weapon Specialization for prerequisites, and the two do not stack on the same weapon.

Prerequisite: Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon.

Choose a single Exotic Weapon or weapon group with which you are proficient. You gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls with such weapons. If you select Heavy Weapons as the weapon group this Talent applies to, you may also use the Talent with Vehicle Weapon attacks.

You may select this Feat multiple times. Each time you select this Feat, it applies to a different Exotic Weapon or weapon group.

choices.noOptions: You Must Be Focussed on a weapon group or an Exotic Weapon to select one for Weapon Specialization.
choices.description: Select a Focussed Weapon to use Weapon Specialization with.
choices.oneOption: You have a single weapon group or exotic weapon that qualifies for Weapon Specialization
